text:
pagerbot: PAGER — Suspicious auth traffic spike from hybrid-proxy pool (10.4.0.0/22). source=proxy-eu-2, rate=~1200/s, 401s rising, potential token replay. Priority: HIGH

alice.m: acked. pulling logs now, going to run a narrow search on svc tokens and user-agent anomalies.

ben_p: joining. I'll check proxy egress rules and recent deploys to proxy-eu-2. No deploys in last 3h from my side.

carol: noticed similar 401 spike at ~1910101900 in staging. can we confirm headers? any common x-forwarded-for patterns?

alice.m: query running: `index=auth proxy=proxy-eu-2 status=401 | top 50 token_id | where count>50`

ben_p: quick grep on access logs shows repeated auth header fragments, some tokens reused across distinct IPs. sample: `svc-az1-*-token: eyJhbGci...`

sec_oncall: Recommend immediate containment: 1) block 10.4.0.0/22 at edge WAF 2) revoke affected service token(s) 3) kick off keystore rotation for service-account:infra-ingest.

sre_lead: Can we do targeted WAF rule instead of full / block? customer impact risk if we block whole pool. what's traffic breakdown by customer?

alice.m: breakdown: ~65% requests are unauthenticated 401s, 30% appear from internal service accounts (svc-ingest), 5% legit customers. If we block the whole pool we'll break some internal jobs.

ben_p: mitigation plan: add rate-limit rule for unknown tokens + temporary WAF signature for repetitive header pattern. block only new source IPs beyond a threshold (100 req/min). I'll push ACL in 2m.

sec_oncall: while ACL goes out, we should rotate the exposed token(s). list I have: `svc-ingest-production-2026` and `svc-az1-backup-12`. Please confirm before rotation.

alice.m: confirmed both tokens observed in logs. starting token revoke workflow. will mark them compromised.

customersuccess: flagging potential customer impact: two customers show increased error rates on ingest (cust-alpha, cust-gamma). I'll prepare a short heads-up note once we have ETA for rotation completion.

ben_p: ACL rule deployed to edge-proxy within 90s. added rate-limit + header pattern match. monitoring.

pagerbot: Deploy bot: ACL change rolled to proxy-eu-2 by ben_p (deploy-id: dpl-191010-7).

alice.m: token revoke initiated: `kms revoke svc-ingest-production-2026` -> job started. Also creating new creds: `svc-ingest-production-2026-v2`.

sec_oncall: coordinate with platform to update secret in k8s secretstore and trigger rolling restart for ingest workers. Use canary rollout: 5% first.

ben_p: triggered secret update for infra-ingest; patch applied to 3 pods for canary.

carol: logs show immediate drop in replay attempts against the revoked token after 30s. good signal.

customersuccess: drafting message: "We observed suspicious traffic affecting ingest for some customers. We've rotated affected service tokens and applied mitigations; root cause investigation underway. No evidence of data exfiltration at this time." Want final wording reviewed before send.

sre_lead: good. Wait for post-rotation metrics. If canary healthy for 10m, roll to 100%.

alice.m: canary looks clean at +6m. no new 401 burst. rotating second token now and replacing in deployments.

sec_oncall: run live scan on object storage access logs for keys associated with those tokens, just in case. I don't see initial evidence, but let's be thorough.

ben_p: second token rotated and canary started. full rollout pending 10m stability check.

pagerbot: metric alert clear: auth.401 spike back to baseline.

carol: running S3 access correlation. nothing suspicious in 1910101800-1910102500 window for those service principals.

customersuccess: sending customer heads-up now (no PII, succinct). cc: legal.

sec_oncall: open incident ticket INF-191010-KEYROT. Assigning sec_oncall and alice.m for follow-up and timeline.

sre_lead: nice quick tempo. postmortem owner? alice.m volunteer?

alice.m: ok I'll own the postmortem. will include timeline, detection gaps, recommendations (improve token TTLs, add token reuse detection rule, tighten rate limits by default).

ben_p: plan item: automate ACL pattern creation from replay signature and add one-click token rotate runbook.

customersuccess: I'll follow up with affected customers with summary and next steps.

pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation complete and tokens rotated. Incident closed for now.

alice.m: closing notes: flagged for follow-up triage meeting tomorrow 09:30.

sec_oncall: added action items to INF-191010-KEYROT: [short-term: increase monitoring, medium: rotate long-lived tokens to ephemeral].

sre_lead: thanks team. great coordination. :tada:
